The '''282nd Regiment''' was an [[Tank/Legends|armored]] [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]]<ref name="282nd tank" /> of 2,304 [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], along with support personnel, that served within one of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Brigade/Legends|brigades]]<ref name="Regiment" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref> Led by a [[clone regimental commander]] and a [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]],<ref name="Regiment leadership" /> the 282nd Regiment was subdivided into four [[Battalion/Legends|battalions]]<ref name="Regiment" /> and utilized at least one [[TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank/Legends|TX-130 ''Saber''-class fighter tank]] with [[Color/Legends|red]] markings,<ref name="282nd tank" /> and one [[All Terrain Attack Pod/Legends|All Terrain Attack Pod]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] with orange markings.<ref name="282nd ATAP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 282nd Regiment was mentioned as part of two vehicle cards for [[WizKids Games]]' [[2007]] ''[[Ground Assault]]'' installment of the [[Star Wars PocketModel TCG|''Star Wars'' PocketModel TCG]] trading card game.<ref name="282nd tank" /><ref name="282nd ATAP" />
